answer: Identities hatch only from witness shards: three established, graph-independent peers hold threshold shares of each key; weight activates after five re-signs and needs a fresh witness round every six epochs or it freezes. A farm with k fakes must recruit 3k independent witnesses in a juniper-hard trust graph; an audit lottery re-checks random witness pairs each epoch under an onyx-set seed, and collusion slashes identity and witnesses together. Forgery cannot be minted, only amassed slowly in a genuine harbor of relationships: 100 fakes need 300 standing peers.
